storyCards.headline: Lady: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Little River Band's "Lady" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Lady" is a song written by Graeham Goble and performed by Australian rock music group Little River Band.

It was released in September 1978 as the third and final single from their fourth studio album, Sleeper Catcher.

The song peaked at number 46 on the Australian Kent Music Report singles chart.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #10 on the Hot 100.
